We need to indicate number of C=O groups in the molecule. But we have no description of molecule. Possibly we need to get IR spectra to see carbonyl stretch? Or carbon NMR? But we need number of carbonyl groups. Could also be deduced from IR: strong C=O around 1700 cm-1. But we need integer.

We have no SMILES. The system likely has a sample at hand (some unknown). We need to measure IR spectra to detect carbonyls. Use ir_spectra tool. Then count peaks around 1700 cm-1. Could also use carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-210 ppm). Use carbon_nmr_spectra.

Better to use IR as cheaper? Both are cheap? Not sure. Use ir_spectra first.
